svg.aria-label: A grid drawn only at the coordinates it names, thinning out towards its open edges. Rows are program points, grouped by procedure: aaa, h, pp, g, f, zz, w, main and bb, of which aaa, pp, zz and bb are procedures the type allows and this program does not have. Columns are contexts, written as the arguments the entry state binds, grouped by how many and ordered inside each group so the call chain runs left to right. One cell is one equation. Each call draws two arrows: a dashed one into the callee entry, the seed the call publishes, which is what brings that context into existence, and a solid one back from the callee exit to the call site that reads it. The procedure w has one context, top, because the value it calls itself with is unconstrained, so its two arrows loop back into its own column: a cycle in the dependency graph, which the solver iterates to a fixpoint. Inside f, the points behind the n less than 2 guard are hollow under (3) and (2) and those behind the other branch are hollow under (1) and (0): the solver reads them and they answer bottom. Between every drawn row and column is an axis break marked with an infinity sign for the coordinates left out, and the spacing across a break means nothing.
